question: After the branch is refreshed against current main and required checks finish, should this protected Slack test-stability fix be merged?
rationale: The `maintainer` label requires an explicit human merge decision even though the patch is narrow, proof-positive, and has no identified mechanical repair.

options.title: Refresh and merge
options.body: Update the branch or evaluate the current merge result, then merge if the full Slack suite and required checks remain green.

options.title: Pause for deeper harness review
options.body: Keep the PR open only if maintainers want a broader review of the shared non-isolated Slack test-client lifecycle before adopting this focused fix.

recommendation.title: Refresh and merge
recommendation.body: Update the branch or evaluate the current merge result, then merge if the full Slack suite and required checks remain green.

likelyOwner.reason: They recently carried the adjacent durable-ingress Slack work and can provide the most direct context for the test lifecycle change.
